args.body: Error on my part: the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14 also hit 22 FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT products (P-1201 to P-1222), which were meant to be excluded. Since then 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, an overcharge of 4,128.60. Proposed fix: revert the 22 prices to their pre-10-14 values, then correct or credit the 8 orders (customer-facing, so needs your/sales ops approval). I haven't reverted yet because I couldn't retrieve the original price history from the catalog. Please confirm the original prices or approve reverting by dividing by 1.03 and rounding to the cent.
